text: APPROVE. The extracted `JudgeRegistration` and `TryReadVerbCall` keep every original guard, early exit and `route({...})` branch in the same order with the same results, and out-parameters are assigned on all paths. Both helpers and the loop are well under 15 in complexity, and I see no unused variables, definite-assignment problems or nullability issues that would break a warnings-as-errors build. I reviewed the diff by reading only; I did not build it. One residual risk: `middle = []` needs C# 12, which I am assuming the project's language version allows.
